release_note.behavior: The recursive backtracker now uses explicit heap DFS frames and a flat visited bitmap, eliminating native call-stack growth while preserving every seeded raster golden.
release_note.api: byul_maze_generate_recursive_backtracker adds replayable seed, cancellation, max_steps, max_cells, status, and failure-atomic output controls.
release_note.topology: Every success result is a connected acyclic perfect Maze with V logical cells and V-1 passages.
release_note.compatibility: maze_make_recursive remains exported as a deprecated ABI 1.x forwarder. Equal checked seeds preserve the pre-API traversal order.
